abilities.name: Mirror Reflection of Doom
_curatorNotes: Phantom summon spawns at first DoT tick (Tap E: frame 86, Hold E: frame 101) and explodes at skillHitmarks[hold]+243 frames (~4.05s after spawn). Duration rounded to 4s.
Hold E variant (skillFrames[1]): swap=73, Q=58, D=66, J=59; spawnsAt=101 — overrides summons[0].spawnsAt via variant.summons.
Phantom DoT ticks every 59 frames, 4 ticks total. Explosion at skillHitmarks[hold]+243 frames. DoT and explosion damage not authored as effects — needs reviewer pass.
A1 auto-Phantom during dash (50% explosion DMG, 2s duration after 2s of dash) not modeled — requires complex dash-duration trigger not covered in this pass.
abilities.description:
Creates an illusory Phantom of Fate from coalesced waterspouts.

Phantom
Has the following special properties:
·Continuously taunts nearby opponents, attracting their fire.
·Continuously deals Hydro DMG to nearby opponents.
·When its duration expires, the Phantom explodes, dealing AoE Hydro DMG.

Hold
Utilizes water currents to move backwards swiftly before conjuring a Phantom.

Only one Phantom created by Mirror Reflection of Doom can exist at any time.

abilities.name: Stellaris Phantasm
_curatorNotes: Burst applies Illusory Bubble to enemies at burstHitmark=107 frames (1.78s from cast). Bubble lasts up to 8s (481 frames); on any hit with impulse, bubble pops early and Omen debuff starts for ~5s. The previous variants[]-as-phases curation (Bubble:8 / Omen:5) was a workaround — replaced by a single Illusory Bubble summon here.

Omen window (5s, starts when Bubble pops/ends) is NOT modeled. Requires Summon.terminatesOn:{type:'trigger',...} for hit-with-impulse pop, plus a sequential-spawn semantic (Omen begins where Bubble ends). Both are deferred schema work.
Omen provides a DMG bonus to all party members attacking Omen-affected enemies — not yet authored as an effect.
Bubble does not pop on NoImpulse hits or from freeze-breaking logic (complex conditional in triggerBubbleBurst); caveat for reviewer.
Mobility is omitted because Bubble is enemy-attached (neither 'stationary' nor 'follows' the caster). Acceptable as undefined per current schema.
abilities.description:
Mona summons the sparkling waves and creates a reflection of the starry sky, applying the Illusory Bubble status to opponents in a large AoE.

Illusory Bubble
Traps opponents inside a pocket of destiny and also makes them Wet. Renders weaker opponents immobile.
When an opponent affected by Illusory Bubble sustains DMG, it has the following effects:
·Applies an Omen to the opponent, which gives a DMG Bonus, also increasing the DMG of the attack that causes it.
·Removes the Illusory Bubble, dealing Hydro DMG in the process.

Omen
During its duration, increases DMG taken by opponents.

passives.name: "Come 'n' Get Me, Hag!"
_curatorNotes: A1: After 2s in Illusory Torrent, auto-creates a Phantom (2s duration, 50% explosion DMG of Mirror Reflection). Checks every 2s via recursive task queue in dash.go. Not modeled — requires complex dash-duration trigger. Effect not yet authored — needs reviewer pass.
passives.description:
After she has used Illusory Torrent for 2s, if there are any opponents nearby, Mona will automatically create a Phantom.
A Phantom created in this manner lasts for 2s, and its explosion DMG is equal to 50% of Mirror Reflection of Doom.

constellations.name: Prophecy of Submersion
_curatorNotes: Effect not yet authored — needs reviewer pass. C1 grants reaction bonuses for 8s when any party member hits an Omen-affected enemy: Electro-Charged DMG +15%, Vaporize DMG +15%, Hydro Swirl DMG +15%, Frozen duration +15% (bugged in gcsim), Lunar-Charged +15%, Lunar-Crystallize +15%. Complex trigger (onEnemyDamage with bubble/omen status check). Reviewer to decide target model and whether reaction-type bonuses need a new Effect type.
constellations.description:
When any of your own party members hits an opponent affected by an Omen, the effects of Hydro-related Elemental Reactions are enhanced for 8s:
· Electro-Charged DMG increases by 15%, Lunar-Charged DMG increases by 15%, Vaporize DMG increases by 15%, Hydro Swirl DMG increases by 15%, Lunar-Crystallize DMG increases by 15%.
· Frozen duration is extended by 15%.

constellations.name: Rhetorics of Calamitas
_curatorNotes: C6 is a stacking mechanic: each second of Illusory Torrent dash grants one stack of +60% DMG to next CA (max 3 stacks = 180% cap; stacks reset on CA use or after 8s). Effect 1 stat 'atk%' is wrong — gcsim uses DmgP (allDmgBonus on the CA only). Effect 2 value 180 is the per-use cap, not a permanent flat bonus. Both effects have trigger 'manual' inherited from generator. Reviewer to remodel as stacking/ramping chargeDmgBonus with max 3 stacks, triggered by Illusory Torrent (dash) entry.
constellations.description:
Upon entering Illusory Torrent, Mona gains a 60% increase to the DMG of her next Charged Attack per second of movement.
A maximum DMG Bonus of 180% can be achieved in this manner. The effect lasts for no more than 8s.
